summary.text: The Egba rebuilt themselves at Abeokuta behind walls, and beat Dahomey there twice. They bought guns through Lagos and sided with Ijaye and the Ekitiparapo against Ibadan.

record.text: Dahomey’s army, its women soldiers among it, was beaten at the walls of Abeokuta.
A second Dahomean attack on Abeokuta failed.
The Egba fought for Ijaye, which Ibadan destroyed.
